column1: # source: GitHub Actions run 34408076490 (yotamleo/Himmel), PR #598, head d026803c,
# Read by scripts/ci/run-shell-tests.sh to assign --shard <i>/<n> by a greedy
# longest-first bin-pack instead of round-robin ($SUITE_DURATIONS overrides this
# path). Keys are the suite path exactly as that runner PRINTS it, which is also
# exactly what the regeneration command below harvests out of a job log — so the
# spelling written here and the spelling matched against cannot drift apart.
# STALENESS: this is a snapshot, bumped on demand, not a CI-maintained file. It
# tunes balance only; it can never change which suites run. A suite absent from
# it is assigned the median of the rows present and runs like any other — never
# dropped. A row naming a suite that no longer exists is ignored. If the file is
# missing, unreadable, empty or malformed the runner says so once on stderr and
# falls back to round-robin. So a stale ledger costs wall clock, nothing else;
# refresh it when the corpus has moved enough that the shard times skew.
